fidelity: F2a — Transcritical Thermodynamic Cycle + Lumped Gas-Cooler/Water Thermal ODE
source: Lorentzen, G. (1994). Revival of carbon dioxide as a refrigerant. Int. J. Refrigeration 17(5), 292-301. Kim, M.-H., Pettersen, J., Bullard, C.W. (2004). Fundamental process and system design issues in CO2 vapor compression systems. Progress in Energy and Combustion Science 30(2), 119-174. Sarkar, J., Bhattacharyya, S., Ram Gopal, M. (2004). Int. J. Refrigeration 27, 830-838. Liao, S.M., Zhao, T.S., Jakobsen, A. (2000). Appl. Thermal Eng. 20, 831-841.

unit.name: Generic 50 kW_th transcritical CO2 (R744) heat pump for high-temperature water heating

rated_heating_capacity.note: Gas-cooler heat rejection at design point

eta_isentropic.note: Compressor isentropic efficiency (Kim 2004 typical reciprocating CO2 compressor 0.6-0.75)

pinch_gc.note: Pinch between CO2 gas-cooler outlet and water inlet

T_crit.note: CO2 critical temperature 30.98 C (NIST / Span & Wagner 1996)

cp_co2_gas.note: CO2 vapor cp near suction, low-pressure approx (NIST ~0.85-1.0)

P_high_opt_a.note: Liao et al. (2000) optimum P_high linear coefficient on T_gc_out

P_high_opt_c.note: Liao-style intercept tuned to transcritical regime (>= ~74 bar)

m_water_tank.note: Lumped thermal mass of gas-cooler water side / buffer

h_fg_evap_ref.note: CO2 latent heat at ~0 C / 35 bar (NIST ~230 kJ/kg; declines toward critical)

co2_property_correlations.note: Hardcoded R744 correlations replacing CoolProp. Real-gas enthalpy along the supercritical gas-cooler isobar and the gliding-temperature behavior are captured by a temperature-dependent supercritical cp(T,P).
co2_property_correlations.source: Fitted to Span, R. & Wagner, W. (1996). A New Equation of State for Carbon Dioxide. J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 25(6), 1509-1596; trends per Kim, Pettersen & Bullard (2004).

cp_super_base.note: Baseline supercritical cp far from pseudocritical point

cp_super_peak.note: Peak cp amplitude at the pseudocritical temperature (cp spikes near critical, Span-Wagner)

T_pseudocrit_ref.note: Pseudocritical temperature at ~90 bar (rises with pressure above T_crit)

pseudocrit_width.note: Gaussian width of the cp hump around pseudocritical T

dTpc_dP.note: Shift of pseudocritical temperature with high-side pressure
